#!__REAL_PYTHON__
"""Owned fault seam: intercept ONLY the exact literal-stdin helper; delegate all else."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys

REAL_PYTHON = __REAL_PYTHON_JSON__
HELPERS = __HELPERS_JSON__
args = sys.argv[1:]
intercept = len(args) == 3 and args[0] in HELPERS and args[1] == "--literal-stdin"
entry = {"at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "argv": sys.argv,
         "delegate": REAL_PYTHON, "action": "intercept" if intercept else "delegate",
         "python_executable": sys.executable}
wire = None
if intercept:
    incoming = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    with open(os.environ["LISA_REVIEW_BOUNDARY_V9_WIRE"], "rb") as source:
        wire = source.read()
    entry.update({"input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(incoming).hexdigest(), "input_bytes": len(incoming),
                  "wire": wire.decode("utf8"), "wire_sha256": hashlib.sha256(wire).hexdigest(),
                  "wire_path": os.environ["LISA_REVIEW_BOUNDARY_V9_WIRE"]})
fd = os.open(os.environ["LISA_REVIEW_BOUNDARY_V9_HELPER_LOG"], os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd, "a") as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
if intercept:
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(wire)
    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
    sys.exit(0)
os.execv(REAL_PYTHON, [REAL_PYTHON] + args)
